text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Is the venue here? Ooh, there sure is a 
crowd gathering."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Man, I can't believe you agreed to help 
out with sandlot baseball... As if your 
trainer job wasn't busy enough as it is."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Actually, some folks from the shopping 
district asked me a few days ago to join 
in on an amateur baseball game.
choice_data_list: Since you're always cheering Nature on...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, yes, everyone has certainly been 
very kind to me, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...But, ah... please don't get too 
carried away and end up hurting yourself, 
okay~?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"You already push yourself too hard as it 
is..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the battle of the shopping 
district sandlot baseball tournament had 
finally begun!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neither team is giving an inch, and the 
match heats up while remaining tied at 
0-0.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Boy, things are really heating up~. 
...Wait, Trainer, you look completely 
wiped out.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Objectively speaking, you've been working 
really hard, so I think it's fine if 
someone took over for you soon.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man, what a hothead... ...Wait, that's 
right. You're working hard because of 
everything I put you through, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Look, I'll go grab us something to drink, 
so just sit tight, okay?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... Let's see, where is the 
executive committee's tent...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text:
"Man, just a little bit more, though. 
They're working so hard, but it's just not 
turning into points..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: (Oh, are they talking about Trainer... ?)

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Woman
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she really is nervous after 
all. She's here as a sub, surrounded by 
people she doesn't know, so...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Man
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Isn't there some way I can cheer 
them up?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(...Or rather... this story sounds 
familiar...)

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Locals
text_block_list.text:
Nei-chaaan!! Go for it, right there!! Keep 
it up, Nei-chaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Being able to meet an Umamusume like you 
has been an irreplaceable treasure to us."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(Whenever I felt like giving it my all, 
everyone and Trainer-san were always right 
there to give me that push forward...)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
(Then instead of just worrying, this time 
I'll—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The bottom of the 9th had finally arrived. 
With the chance to walk it off with just 
one hit, it was now my turn at bat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing on the mound before me is an 
older guy boasting a mighty arm, who's 
even had experience making the bench at 
Koshien.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Already driven to two strikes, it felt 
like this was the end—or so I thought, 
until that very moment.
Go for it—!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Don't lose, Trainer! Just one more hit! If 
you hit this, you win!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Cheer up! Get pumped! Everyone, on three!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Folk
text_block_list.text: Yay! Go, fight, win!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: D-Do your best, Trainer-saaaan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature cheering for me shyly... and 
everyone else around us. I've got to live 
up to their support no matter what...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Go get 'em--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*CRACK!*)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yay~! You did it! Not bad at all, 
Trainer-san! A home run! It's a walk-off 
win!
choice_data_list: Thank you so, so much for your support!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... When you look at me with sparkling 
eyes like that, it kinda makes me blush...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...If anything, I'm the one who should be 
thanking you. Thank YOU as always for all 
your support!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's keep giving it our best from 
now on... Aaargh, that totally wasn't like 
me to say, jeez!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though feeling shy, Nice Nature showed her 
heartfelt support. It was a day that 
became an irreplaceable memory!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Alright! Not bad, Trainer. Good work!
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to Nice Nature's support!

It's all thanks to Nice Nature cheering me 
on!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, not at all. It's all thanks to 
your hard work and talent, Trainer. Well, 
but still..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, you're actually pretty fun to 
cheer for. Next time you play baseball, 
maybe I'll come cheer you on again... Just 
kidding."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature averts her gaze shyly. Yet, 
feeling a definite bond with her, it 
turned out to be a wonderful day!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... that was so embarrassing! 
Nature-san is really, really not cut out 
for this kind of thing!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ack, don't yell so loud! You're drawing 
everyone's attention over here! Jeez, I'll 
go change, alright?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Well, if I was able to help, I guess 
that's good.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature is still unable to be honest 
with herself. Yet, it was a precious day 
where I could truly feel how she felt!
